skill_name: Describe the differences between an online store and a brick-and-mortar store.
workflow: An online store is an online presence for a business that allows customers to browse, purchase, and pay for goods and services through the internet, typically from the comfort of their own home. A brick-and-mortar store, on the other hand, is a physical store where customers can personally enter and browse products in order to purchase them.
